scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Oh, it's you again.
So did you try finding
that nutcase scientist
who lives over in Geffen?
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
啊，又是你啊。
你去找过那个住在吉芬的
疯科学家了吗？

scripts.text: Talk About Morgenstein
scripts.translation: 谈谈莫根斯坦

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
You know where he lives
but didn't check it out? Hey,
he may be off his rocker, but
I guess most geniuses are
like that. Still, I think it'd be^FFFFFFss^000000 a good idea if you see him.
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
你知道他住哪，
却不去看看？嘿，
他虽然有点疯，
但我想大多数天才
都是那样的。不过，我觉得^FFFFFF去^000000见见他是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
I mean...
It's only a matter
of time until a smart guy
like that creates something
truly miraculous, right?
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
我是说...
像他那样聪明的人，
迟早会创造出
真正奇迹般的发明，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
...Hello?
Hellooo? Hey.
Hey! I'm talkin'
to you! Man, I hate
it when you adventurers
just shut up and space out...
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
...喂？
喂？嘿。
嘿！我在跟你说话呢！
真讨厌，你们这些冒险者
总是沉默不语，发呆走神...

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Heya.
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
嗨。
有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Talk about the solutions.
scripts.translation: 谈谈那些溶液

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
When I was in Geffen
looking for magic items,
I heard rumors of this really
crazy scientist guy. So I got
curious, asked around, and
eventually found this guy.
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
我之前在吉芬
寻找魔法物品时，
听说了这个非常疯狂的科学家。于是我感到好奇，四处打听，
最终找到了这个人。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Boy, oh boy, this guy was
screwy. He didn't even know
I was there the whole time and
just kept mumbling this mumbo
jumbo while working on his
experiments. Words like, um...
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
天哪，这家伙
真够疯的。他完全没注意到
我在那里，只是一直嘟囔着
一些胡言乱语，同时在做他的实验。那些词大概是...

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Yeah, he kept mumbling
words like ''Karvodailnirol''
and ''Detrimindexta.'' The
first time I heard it, I thought
it was just crazy talk, you know?
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
对，他一直嘟囔着
“卡勒波迪”和
“帝特立米”之类的词。
我第一次听到时，
以为只是在说疯话，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
But it turns out,
this Karvodailnirol
and Detrimindexta actually
exist. I think they're special
liquids that don't work quite
like any liquids we're used to.
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
但事实证明，
卡勒波迪和帝特立米
确实存在。我想它们是特殊的液体，
性质与我们熟悉的任何液体都不同。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Hey, this is one of
those solutions that
scientist kept mentioning.
You were able to get one
of these? Huh. Now, I have
no idea what to do with them...
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
嘿，这是那个科学家
一直提到的溶液之一。
你居然弄到了其中一个？
嗯。现在，我完全不知道该怎么处理它们...

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Ah, but that crazy
scientist would know.
I don't remember exactly
where he lives, but I know
he's in Geffen and that his
name is ^0000FFMorgenstein^000000.
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
啊，但那个疯狂的科学家
肯定知道。
我不记得他具体住哪，
但我知道他在吉芬，
而且他的名字是^0000FF莫根斯坦^000000。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Hmm... You better
go around Geffen and
around first. I know for
ask around first. I know for
sure that somebody knows
where you can find Morgenstein.
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
嗯...你最好
先在吉芬四处转转。
我知道肯定有人
知道在哪里能找到莫根斯坦。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Um...
Good talking
to you pal. Uh,
see ya 'round. Take
care of yourself, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
嗯...
和你聊天很开心，朋友。呃，
回见。照顾好自己，好吗？

It seems that our
paths yet cross again.
Coincidence? It's more
than that. This is ^0000FFfate^000000.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷·杜邦]
看来我们的命运
再次交汇了。
巧合吗？
不仅仅是巧合，这是^0000FF命运^000000。

scripts.text: Talk About Morgenstein
scripts.translation: 谈谈莫根斯坦

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Have you not met
Morgenstein yet? He
lives on the second floor
of the Forge. Although we've
just met, I must warn you not
to get too close to him...
scripts.translation:
[奥雷·杜邦]
你还没见过
摩根斯坦吗？
他住在锻造厂的二楼。
虽然我们才刚见面，
但我必须提醒你，
不要靠他太近...

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Go then, and
may the tides of
destiny carry you
to where you must go.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷·杜邦]
去吧，
愿命运的洪流
将你带往
你该去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Time flows gently
and subtly, but no
force in this world
can possibly stop it.
Mankind is not even a
mote in the grand scheme.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷·杜邦]
时间缓缓而微妙地流逝，
但世间没有任何力量
能够阻止它。
人类在宏大的命运中
甚至只是一粒尘埃。

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Ask About Morgenstein
scripts.translation: 询问关于摩根斯坦的事

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
To have goals and focus
is good, but to be obsessive
about one single thing can be
quite destructive. Relax, empty
your mind, and let yourself be
carried by the tides of destiny.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷·杜邦]
有目标并专注是好事，
但执着于一件事
可能会带来破坏。
放松，放空你的思绪，
让自己随命运的洪流前行。

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Morgenstein...?
The man is obsessed
with conquering the forces
that control our world. But
you seem to be curious about
him for some reason. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[奥雷·杜邦]
摩根斯坦...？
那个男人痴迷于
征服控制我们世界的力量。
但你似乎对他
有些好奇。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
It would be best if you
were to see Morgenstein
and judge his character for
yourself. You may find him in
the second floor of the Geffen
Forge. Go: It is your destiny.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷·杜邦]
最好是你亲自去见见摩根斯坦，
判断他的为人。
你可以在吉芬锻造厂的二楼找到他。
去吧：这是你的命运。

scripts.text:

may the tides of

to where you must go.

你该去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
.....
Welcome.
Hehehehe....
Heeheeheeheehee....
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
.....
欢迎。
嘿嘿嘿嘿....
嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿....

scripts.text: Ask about his research
scripts.translation: 询问他的研究

scripts.text: Ask him to make a new solution.
scripts.translation: 请他制作新的溶液

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heeheeheeheee...
You must have heard the rumors about my research. Yes! But since you probably know already, I'll tell you without hiding, I mean, there's nothing to hide.
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿嘿...
你肯定听说过关于我研究的传闻吧。是的！
不过既然你可能已经知道了，
我就直说吧，
我是说，没什么好隐瞒的。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Actually, you can say my research is complete! Nothing's impossible for my genius! Bwahaha, it's just a matter of time!
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
其实，你可以说我的研究已经完成了！
没有什么是不可能的，对于我的天才来说！
哇哈哈哈，只是时间问题！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Are you still here? Right, you wanted to know about my research. It's actually very simple. I was just trying to invent a super liquid that can melt everything!
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
你还在这里吗？
对了，你想知道关于我研究的事。
其实很简单。
我只是想发明一种能融化一切的超级液体！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Isn't it interesting? No matter how strong you are, you can't break apart stone or steel, but with my new liquid, you can melt those things, making them soft like puddy!
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
是不是很有趣？
无论多强壮，你都打不碎石头或钢铁，
但用我的新液体，
你可以融化它们，让它们变得像泥巴一样软！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
It can't melt everything yet, but I did find that you could combine things that you could never mix before with my invention. Heeheeheehee~!
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
它还不能融化所有东西，
但我发现用我的发明，
你可以混合以前根本无法混合的东西。
嘿嘿嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
You can make a whole lot of things that you'd never would have imagined possible! I can make you a lot of new things you never would have imagined using this method... as long as you want it!!
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
你可以做出很多你从未想象过的东西！
用这种方法，我可以为你制作很多你从未想象过的东西...
只要你想要！！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
The endorphins are rushing to my face at least 2.1 times faster than the usual rate! Ah! I'm so excited! I... I just can't hide it!
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
内啡肽涌上我脸部的速度至少比平时快2.1倍！
啊！我太兴奋了！我...我根本藏不住！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
So...
You want me to make something totally new, huh? Hehhehheh! I love your sense of scientific adventure!
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
所以...
你想让我制作点全新的东西，是吗？
嘿嘿嘿嘿！我喜欢你的科学冒险精神！

scripts.text: Counteragent
scripts.translation: 中和剂

scripts.text: Mixture
scripts.translation: 混合物

scripts.text:

You want to make a Counteragent? Hohohohoho, let's see what we'll need...

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Oh, I remember, yes, Alcohol, and um, er, Detrimindexta and an Empty Bottle to put it it all in. Just these three items and 3000 zeny.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Oh, I just can't wait to make this! Are you ready to begin?

嘿...嘿乌嘿乌嘿乌...

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heehee....heheheheh....
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿...嘿嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heeheeheehee.... welcome. Hehehehe.... heeheeheeheehee....
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿嘿...欢迎。嘿嘿嘿嘿...嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Ah...?!
So sorry if I weirded you out. It's just... I haven't seen a living person in soooo long. So, er, what can I do for you??
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
啊...？！
抱歉，如果我让你感到奇怪了。只是...我已经很久很久没见过活人了。所以，呃，有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Ask about his research.
scripts.translation: 询问他的研究

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heeheeheeheee...
You must have heard the rumors about my research. Yes! But since you probably know already, I'll tell you without hiding, I mean, there's nothing to hide.
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿嘿...
你肯定听说过关于我研究的传闻吧。是的！
不过既然你可能已经知道了，
我就直说吧，
我是说，没什么好隐瞒的。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Actually, you can say my research is complete! Nothing's impossible for my genius! Bwahaha, it's just a matter of time!
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
其实，你可以说我的研究已经完成了！
没有什么是不可能的，对于我的天才来说！
哇哈哈哈，只是时间问题！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Are you still here? Right, you wanted to know about my research. It's actually very simple. I was just trying to invent a super liquid that can melt everything!
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
你还在这里吗？
对了，你想知道关于我研究的事。
其实很简单。
我只是想发明一种能融化一切的超级液体！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Isn't it interesting? No matter how strong you are, you can't break apart stone or steel, but with my new liquid, you can melt those things, making them soft like puddy!
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
是不是很有趣？
无论多强壮，你都打不碎石头或钢铁，
但用我的新液体，
你可以融化它们，让它们变得像泥巴一样软！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
It can't melt everything yet, but I did find that you could combine things that you could never mix before with my invention.
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
它还不能融化所有东西，但我发现用我的发明，你可以混合以前根本无法混合的东西。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
I can make you a lot of new things you never would have imagined using this method... as long as you want it!!
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
用这种方法，我可以为你制作出许多你从未想象过的新东西……只要你想要！！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
The endorphins are rushing to my face at least 2.1 times faster than the usual rate! Ah! I'm so excited! I... I just can't hide it!
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
内啡肽涌上我脸部的速度至少比平时快2.1倍！
啊！我太兴奋了！我...我根本藏不住！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heeheeheehee...
You're not here to be a test subject, are you? Probably not though. Not since my little 'accident.' Heeheeheeee~!
scripts.translation:
[化学家 摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿嘿...
你不是来做实验品的吧？大概不是吧。自从我的小“事故”之后，应该就不会了。嘿嘿嘿嘿~！
